new_categories.label: water_ingress_detection_function_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo hold water-ingress detection readiness is a protective service-state distinct from hatch-cover condition, ventilation and machinery-space bilge service.

new_categories.label: hold_bilge_well_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Detection/drainage assurance can be localized to an affected hold, bilge well or related bounded cargo-space scope without retaining exact arrangement or location.

new_categories.label: water_presence_level_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Non-numeric water-presence or level-indication confidence is distinct from detector physical readiness and does not retain actual levels or thresholds.

new_categories.label: alarm_monitoring_confidence
new_categories.memory: Alarm/monitoring confidence can degrade separately from detector function and from the physical water condition in the hold.

new_categories.label: drainage_path_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-hold drainage-path readiness is distinct from water-ingress detection readiness and from pump/support readiness without retaining routing or valve lineups.

new_categories.label: pump_support_readiness
new_categories.memory: Pump or equivalent drainage-support readiness can be represented separately from the path and the monitored hold/bilge-well scope without capacity or operating detail.

new_categories.label: drainage_boundary_isolation_confidence
new_categories.memory: A bounded drainage/isolation-boundary confidence state can be retained without specifying actual valves, non-return devices, positions or lineups.

new_categories.label: monitoring_validity_cross_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring validity or cross-check confidence is distinct from mere alarm/indication presence and can degrade independently.

new_categories.label: hold_availability_not_bilge_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Hold availability or cargo-condition confidence is a downstream outcome and not equivalent to detector, drainage-path or pump/support state.

new_categories.label: hold_bilge_water_ingress_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to detector function, hold/bilge-well scope, indication, alarm/monitoring, drainage path, pump/support or drainage boundary.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-condition concern, hold restriction, loading/discharge limitation, port rework or schedule effects do not prove a detector, ingress source, drainage path, pump/support or hold-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_hold_bilge_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical correction, drainage-path recovery, pump/support recovery, indication/alarm return, monitoring validity verification and hold release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: machinery_oily_bilge_vs_cargo_hold_bilge
useful_refinements.memory: P075 machinery oily-water/bilge service does not duplicate dry-cargo hold water-ingress detection and cargo-space drainage assurance.

useful_refinements.label: hatch_cover_service_vs_water_ingress_assurance
useful_refinements.memory: P086 hatch-cover/access readiness can affect ingress risk but does not establish water-ingress detection, hold-bilge indication or drainage readiness.

useful_refinements.label: cargo_space_ventilation_vs_hold_bilge_service
useful_refinements.memory: P089 cargo-space ventilation/air-exchange assurance is distinct from water-ingress detection, bilge-well monitoring and drainage service.

useful_refinements.label: electrical_support_vs_delivered_detection_drainage
useful_refinements.memory: P070 electrical-power availability may support detection or pumping but does not establish delivered hold-bilge detection/drainage readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_detection_path_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic detector/path/support degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_verification_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope-localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.
